about: Prompts phrased the way developers ask. expect: skills that count as a correct load (any one is enough); [] means no Memgraph skill should load; null means no skill covers it yet (reported, not scored). Prompts with ids starting ho- were written after the descriptions were rewritten in 2026-11 and never used to tune them; compare them to catch descriptions fitted to the other prompts.

prompts.prompt: Get started with Memgraph
I want to try Memgraph on my laptop with some sample data to play with.

My Memgraph query is really slow, it takes 30 seconds:
MATCH (a:Account)-[:SENT]->(t:Tx)-[:TO]->(b:Account) WHERE a.id = 42 RETURN b
Make sure no two Person nodes in my Memgraph database can have the same email.
Lookups by customer id are slow in Memgraph. What should I add?
How do I find the shortest path between two users in Memgraph?
Write a Memgraph query that returns everything within 3 hops of a product, following only BOUGHT and VIEWED relationships.
I'm about to load 50 million edges into Memgraph. Should I change any settings first, and how do I switch back afterwards?
In Memgraph, set updated_at on a node automatically whenever one of its properties changes.
Memgraph is using way more RAM than I expected. How do I find out why and bring it down?
I have CSV files with users and their transactions. Load them into Memgraph.
We're moving from Neo4j to Memgraph. How do I get our data over?
